comments.author: Faisal
comments.body: Why is this not in Faisal's Treasure Box?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: "Faisal's Treasure Box"? That brings back some pleasant memories for this old sea dog. Ahem... this item is basically the Mitraf with a slightly unique color scheme; it was only available from the Eternal Voyager Box item -- due to a combination of low stats and non-existent demand for it, I don't believe it will ever appear on Maris.
